label_policy: Labels are manual passage-content judgments. USEFUL means directly answers an aspect; PARTIAL means relevant but incomplete/indirect; IRRELEVANT means no useful support for this question. Retrieval rank and distance were not used as label criteria. The judged candidate window is Top 6 per paper per query source, not the whole-paper relevance universe.
